name: Apex Hunter
behavior: Improves critical-hit chances against enemies at full health.
response: Use it for your opening strike on an undamaged enemy.

name: Glass Cannon
behavior: Increases damage but lowers your maximum Energy.
response: Choose it when you can manage the smaller Energy reserve.
warning: Taking it also removes any current Energy above the new cap.

name: Sharp Blade
behavior: Increases the damage you deal.
response: Choose it for a damage boost without a low-Energy or wounded-target requirement.

name: Berserker
behavior: Increases damage while your Energy is low.
response: Use the bonus when it activates, while preserving enough Energy to survive and move.
warning: The bonus depends on your current Energy.

name: Cleave
behavior: Your strike also damages enemies beside you.
response: Attack when multiple enemies are adjacent to get value from the extra damage.
warning: It does not remove the danger of standing beside several enemies.

name: Poison Blade
behavior: Strikes can poison a non-boss enemy, causing damage over time.
response: After poison lands, keep dodging while it works.
warning: It does not poison the final boss.

name: Critical Boost
behavior: Improves your chance to land a critical hit.
response: Choose it to strengthen critical-hit opportunities across ordinary attacks.
warning: A critical hit is not guaranteed.

name: Frenzy
behavior: Kills can ready bonus damage for your next strike.
response: Use the primed damage bonus on your next target.
warning: It boosts the next strike rather than permanently raising damage after every kill.

name: Merciless
behavior: Increases damage against enemies at half health or lower.
response: Use it to finish enemies you have already wounded.

name: Reach
behavior: A strike can also hit a second enemy directly behind your first target.
response: Line up two enemies in the same row or column.
warning: The second target must be in line with the first.

name: Heavy Hitter
behavior: Increases attack power, but each strike costs 1 Energy.
response: Account for the added Energy cost before committing to a long fight.
warning: More attack power also means spending Energy on strikes.

name: Apex Guard
behavior: Reduces the first hit from an enemy that is still at full health.
response: Treat it as a cushion against an opening ambush.
warning: It does not protect against traps or repeatedly reduce the same enemy's attacks.

name: Divine Shield
behavior: Can block an incoming enemy hit.
response: Keep dodging; use the occasional block as extra protection.
warning: It does not block trap damage, and it is not guaranteed.

name: Armor Plating
behavior: Reduces damage from enemy attacks and traps such as spikes and arrows.
response: Choose it for protection across combat and hazards.
warning: Does not reduce lava damage or damage over time from poison and burn.

name: Thorns
behavior: Reflects some damage from melee strikes back at the attacker.
response: Treat the reflected damage as a bonus when a melee hit gets through.
warning: It is not retaliation against arrows or traps.

name: Greed
behavior: Increases treasure earnings at the cost of taking more damage.
response: Weigh the extra treasure against the reduced margin for mistakes.
warning: Extra floor treasure starts on later floors; the damage penalty applies immediately.

name: Prospector
behavior: Improves the chance of finding an item in breakable objects.
response: Check pots and crates as you explore.
warning: It does not guarantee an item from each object.

name: Scavenger
behavior: Improves the chance that breakable objects produce loot.
response: Check breakables along your route for supplies.
warning: It does not guarantee a drop.

name: Swift Steps
behavior: Grants free moves at the beginning of each floor.
response: Use the free movement allowance while exploring the new floor.
warning: Free movement does not prevent damage from attacks or hazards.

name: Survival Instinct
behavior: Grants free moves when Energy falls below 10.
response: Use the emergency movement to reach supplies or a safer position.
warning: It activates only once per floor and does not make you invulnerable.

name: Momentum
behavior: Kills build toward free movement.
response: Use the free moves earned through combat to continue exploring.
warning: The number of kills needed depends on its enhancement level.

name: Last Stand
behavior: Lets you survive a fatal hit and recover Energy.
response: Use the recovery to escape danger or reach more Energy.
warning: It can save you only once per floor.

name: Vampiric
behavior: Kills build toward restoring Energy.
response: Use combat rewards to help sustain your run.
warning: The number of kills needed depends on its enhancement level.

name: Salvage
behavior: Breaking ordinary pots and crates restores Energy.
response: Break objects along your route when you need recovery.
warning: A mimic reveal is not an ordinary breakable recovery.

name: Renewal
behavior: Restores Energy at the start of each floor.
response: Factor the recovery into your plans for the next floor.

name: Scout
behavior: Extends your vision range.
response: Use the wider view to spot routes and threats earlier.

name: Corruption
behavior: Strikes can turn a non-boss enemy against another enemy.
response: Use the interruption to reposition while the corrupted enemy attacks.
warning: The effect ends after its attack; it is not a permanent ally.

name: Disrupt
behavior: Strikes can briefly stun an enemy.
response: Use a successful stun to reposition or continue attacking.
warning: The stun is not guaranteed.

name: Menace
behavior: A kill can frighten nearby enemies and briefly stop their actions.
response: Defeat an enemy near others to create a possible opening.
warning: It does not frighten the final boss.
